name: Anantara Siam Bangkok Hotel
positioning: Anantara's flagship Bangkok hotel on Ratchadamri Road, with hand-painted silk murals, tropical gardens and views over the Royal Bangkok Sports Club golf course
best_for: Travelers who want a central Bangkok base beside the skytrain
Guests who want Thai design with garden and pool views in the city
Families looking for a Kids' Club and villa or two-bedroom options

facts.text: The hotel is on Ratchadamri Road beside Ratchadamri BTS Station, with the skytrain just steps away.
High chandeliered ceilings, hand-painted silk murals and lush gardens give the hotel a feeling of sanctuary in the city.
The building opened in 1982 as a Peninsula, later operated as a Regent and a Four Seasons, and became Anantara's flagship in 2015 after extensive renovations.
The ornate lobby is topped by a sweeping staircase.
Rooms offer classic Thai style with hand-painted murals or a more contemporary take.
Rooms are styled contemporary Thai with polished teak furnishings and Jim Thompson silk fabrics.
Rooms have garden, cityscape, pool or golf course views, and a marble bathroom with a separate tub and rain shower.
All suite guests enjoy Kasara privileges.
Wellness facilities include the Anantara Spa, a Technogym-equipped fitness centre, outdoor rock climbing, private Muay Thai sessions and Pilates.
The hotel has the VIVID IV Drip Bar.
Dining includes Thai cuisine at Spice Market, Japanese dishes at Shintaro and Italian favourites at Biscotti.
A Kids' Club offers activities for younger guests, and cats and dogs up to 10kg are welcome, with one pet per room.

highlights.text: Hand-painted silk murals, high chandeliered ceilings and lush gardens give the hotel a feeling of sanctuary in the city.
The pool is surrounded by tropical gardens and lotus ponds.
Golf course views look over the private course at the Royal Bangkok Sports Club.
Accommodation includes the Garden Pool Villa with a private pool and the Two Bedroom Jim Thompson Explorer Suite.
The hotel offers morning yoga classes in the adjacent Lumpini Park.

considerations.text: The golf course seen from some rooms is the private course of the Royal Bangkok Sports Club, not a hotel facility.
WhataHotel notes a busy location in a high-traffic tourist area.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing compared with other Bangkok hotels.
